title: Build nondecreasing-weight Graver routes and polynomial-loss physical rooted paths
statement: At base control, Phi_V(z)=sum_i[log(z_i!)-z_i log(Vc_i)] is separable integer convex. Choose a maximum-weight state z_* in the finite buffered actual fibre. A conformal Graver decomposition z_*-z=sum_j g_j satisfies sum_j[Phi(z+g_j)-Phi(z)] <= Phi(z_*)-Phi(z) <= 0. Some feasible move does not increase Phi and strictly reduces distance to z_*, giving O(V) skeleton moves. Compiled physical words have bounded excursions; weight losses are paid relative to the nondecreasing skeleton, rather than multiplied at every step. With H=max(1,c_max,A/c_min), factorial ratios give a weight distortion at most [H(1+V)]^||u-v||_1. Let b0=b_cov+b_tree+b_G and L0=1+ell_cov+ell_tree+d*A*ell_G, using the computed word lengths and excursions. Every state in a core-reaching class has a common-root original-reaction path of length <= L0(1+V), whose vertex weights are at least H^(-d*b0)(1+V)^(-d*b0) times its starting weight. Globally bounded-coordinate classes are covered by the finite recursion.
